ModMetaData.name: ESCP - Maormer
ModMetaData.description: The Elder Scrolls Collaboration Project Presents: Maormer, an Elder Scrolls xenotype and faction mod featuring the Sea Elves of Pyandonea. Based on the original ESCP Maormer by SirMashedPotato, rebuilt to run without Humanoid Alien Races.
